items.title: 3 US Infrastructure Stocks Linked To Air Traffic Network Upgrades
items.summary: A single router failure that halts U.S. air traffic turns abstract “critical infrastructure” into something very real for investors. When the FAA, HPE’s Juniper unit, L3Harris and Cisco are suddenly in the same investigation, risk and potential future contract decisions collide. This piece looks at how that shock ripples through three U.S. listed aviation networking stocks exposed to the news, and why their next chapter may matter for your portfolio. items.title: Musk Says He Offered the FAA Free Starlinks and Was Told They Weren’t Needed
